title: His daughter Inge and grandchildren Tom and Alexandra
summary: His daughter born in 1942 is a bluegrass fiddler in Nashville; grandson Tom plays guitar in a country-pop group, and Alexandra plays clarinet and flute.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Uh-huh, good. You want to say something about your family now? You have your grandchildren and so forth. I think that ought to be something for the record here. You have one daughter. How old is she now?
She was born in '42. And my -- our grandson is going to be 19 in March.
Tommy.
Tom, and Alexandra is 17. And --
Wow.
Yes, a lot has happened.
Right.

And they're all in each one's particular fashion involved some way in music, not necessarily as an important factor. Tommy is quite seriously involved now, he is joining a group that's starting its first road tour in the Carolinas, I think, next week.
What's the name of the group?
I don't know. It's young people who have been involved in the country and bluegrass singing for quite
awhile. But they have a crossover job which is involved (inaudible) with the pop-rock aspect of it.
What does Tommy -- does he play in that?
Yeah, he plays guitar and sings and they're playing some of his songs.
Uh-huh.

And Alex is not sure where she's at with music, except she likes it very much and she was involved in high school as -- something doing the band, playing clarinet I remember, a little bit, and fooled around with the flute and piccolo, so she's involved.
And Inge is professional, has been for some years, right?
Inge is -- right, she's a bluegrass fiddle player (inaudible). And still makes most of her living from that.
And they've been making their home in Nashville for how many years?
Several years now. Eight seven, eight, nine years.
They used to live --
In San Francisco.
-- in the San Francisco area. Well, let's see.
(Recording interrupted.)
